# ZonPrep

ZonPrep is a Warehousing and Storage company. ZonPrep is a company that provides FBA prep and cross-dock services for various industries such as multi-brand operators, cpg, health & beauty, agencies, and warehouses. They offer services such as cross-dock, managed logistics, fba prep & kitting, container & carton processing, and more. ZonPrep employs 31 people (+106.7% YoY, +16 people), founded in 2014. Headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, United States, with an office in McDonough. Its workforce is distributed across United States and Canada.

## About

We are the largest FBA Prep focused 3PL in the country - with over 600,000 square feet in Georgia, we are a full service provider for many large Amazon sellers. In fact, our team previously owned our own 8 figure Amazon brand. We treat our customers' FBA prep like we do our own - which has resulted in a near-flawless, unbeatable 99.9% accuracy over millions of units shipped.

results.text:
# AMZ Prep®

AMZ Prep® is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. AMZ Prep is one of the North America's largest independent FBA prep centers and 3PLs. They offer fulfillment capabilities such as fba prep, dtc fulfillment services, ecommerce fulfillment, b2b retail fulfillment, seller fulfilled prime (sfp 3pl), cold storage 3pl, omnichannel fulfillment, returns services,. AMZ Prep® employs 92 people (+1.1% YoY, +1 person), founded in 2019. Headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, United States, with presence in United Kingdom, Canada, and Netherlands. Its workforce is distributed across Canada, India, United States, and Philippines.

## About

AMZ Prep is one of North America's largest independently owned 3PL and fulfillment networks, founded in 2019. We operate 50+ fulfillment centers across the US, Canada, and Europe, processing 10M+ units monthly and supporting $3B+ in annual GMV for 5,000+ brands including Supergoop!, JBL, Duracell, 437, Eight Sleep, and Unilever.

We move inventory into Amazon faster than competing 3PLs and support brands across every major commerce channel: Amazon FBA prep, Seller Fulfilled Prime, DTC omnichannel fulfillment, big and bulky logistics, cold storage, B2B retail compliance, Middle Mile freight into Amazon FCs in 2 to 4 days, LTL and FTL freight, and Prep Parcel for multi-carrier parcel shipping.

Our proprietary WMS, Navigate, automates shipping plans, real-time inventory tracking, and multi-channel routing across Amazon, Shopify, Walmart, and Target.

AMZ Prep is ISO 9001:2015 certified, FDA-registered, a Shopify-recommended fulfillment partner, and an Amazon-recommended 3PL. We are rated 4.9/5 on G2 and recognized as a Clutch Global B2B Champion in Logistics, 3PL, and Amazon FBA categories.

Enterprise-grade fulfillment. No fixed contracts. Dedicated Slack support with a 2-hour SLA response.

properties.description:
AMZ Prep is one of North America's largest independently owned 3PL and fulfillment networks, founded in 2019. We operate 50+ fulfillment centers across the US, Canada, and Europe, processing 10M+ units monthly and supporting $3B+ in annual GMV for 5,000+ brands including Supergoop!, JBL, Duracell, 437, Eight Sleep, and Unilever.

We move inventory into Amazon faster than competing 3PLs and support brands across every major commerce channel: Amazon FBA prep, Seller Fulfilled Prime, DTC omnichannel fulfillment, big and bulky logistics, cold storage, B2B retail compliance, Middle Mile freight into Amazon FCs in 2 to 4 days, LTL and FTL freight, and Prep Parcel for multi-carrier parcel shipping.

Our proprietary WMS, Navigate, automates shipping plans, real-time inventory tracking, and multi-channel routing across Amazon, Shopify, Walmart, and Target.

AMZ Prep is ISO 9001:2015 certified, FDA-registered, a Shopify-recommended fulfillment partner, and an Amazon-recommended 3PL. We are rated 4.9/5 on G2 and recognized as a Clutch Global B2B Champion in Logistics, 3PL, and Amazon FBA categories.

Enterprise-grade fulfillment. No fixed contracts. Dedicated Slack support with a 2-hour SLA response.
